questions.question: Whom does God call his anointed in Isaiah 45, even though he does not know God?
What does God repeatedly declare about himself in Isaiah 45?
options: I am one among the gods of the earth
I am hidden, and none can find me
My work is finished, and I now rest
I am the LORD, and there is no other
questions.answer: I am the LORD, and there is no other

questions.question: Isaiah 45 says to God, 'Truly, you are a God who hides himself,' and calls every knee to bow.
I am the LORD, and there is no _____; besides me there is no God.
Turn to me and be saved, all the ends of the _____! For I am God, and there is no other.
